description:
Welcome to your peaceful retreat in Mount Juliet!

🛏 The Room
Relax in a cozy queen bed with fresh linens and soft lighting. The room includes a nightstand, and a built-in ceiling fan to keep the temperature just right. The room also includes a mini fridge, and microwave for your convenience.

💻 Work & Productivity
Enjoy a dedicated workspace featuring a sleek desk setup with natural light from the large window — ideal for working remotely or studying in peace.

Other things to note
We have a couple of pets, one lovely cat, and we also have a small 🐶 our friendly Shitzu.
